title: My Neighbor Totoro
tagline: Corn for Mum, cucumbers from the stream.
about: Two young sisters who move to the countryside befriend a giant forest spirit.
cue: Serve the cucumbers when Granny tells the girls to keep pumping till the water gets cold.
